import numpy as np\n\
import pandas as pd\n\
\n\
def calculate_msd(dump_file):\n\
    # Read the dump file\n\
    data = pd.read_csv(dump_file, delim_whitespace=True, skiprows=9, header=None,\n\
                       names=['id', 'type', 'x', 'y', 'z'])\n\
    \n\
    # Group by atom id\n\
    grouped = data.groupby('id')\n\
    \n\
    # Calculate MSD\n\
    msd = []\n\
    for name, group in grouped:\n\
        displacements = (group[['x', 'y', 'z']].diff() ** 2).sum(axis=1)\n\
        msd.append(displacements.mean())\n\
    \n\
    return np.mean(msd)\n\
\n\
if __name__ == '__main__':\n\
    import sys\n\
    dump_file = sys.argv[1]\n\
    msd = calculate_msd(dump_file)\n\
    print(f'Mean Squared Displacement: {msd}')\n\
"
